title: Moche potters produce portrait-head vessels
summary: Moche potters made modeled portrait-head vessels with individualized facial features, especially in the phases conventionally called Moche III and IV.

citations.locator: Moche III (ca. 300–450) and IV (ca. 450–550); molding, individual likeness and interpretive limits
citations.note: Supports the linked claims within the stated date and attribution limits.

claims.text: Moche potters made modeled portrait-head vessels with individualized facial features, especially in the phases conventionally called Moche III and IV.
The essay places Moche III around 300–450 and IV around 450–550. These approximate phase dates do not cover every portrait vessel.
Molds allowed repeated images, sometimes apparently of the same person. The identities and social meanings of these portraits remain debated.

review.corroboration: The Met essay’s phase chronology and interpretive cautions were inspected. A dated example elsewhere on the page falls later; no universal terminal date is claimed.
